name: Luan Yuan
source:
Identity: Tourist
Occupation: Staff at a media company.
Talents: Making decisions while keeping her composure.
Character: Has the temperament of a mature female. She is strongly distrustful of strangers, although she attempts to suppress this feeling.
Dream: Better living conditions in the future.
